children: Arrow Exploration Corp (V.AXL) Hit a new 52-Week High of 60 cents. Late last week, Arrow provided an update on operational activity at the Icaco field on the Tapir Block in the Llanos Basin of Colombia where Arrow holds a 50-percent beneficial interest.

Cascadia Minerals Ltd. (V.CAM) Hit a new 52-Week High of 45 cents. Last week, Cascadia announced drill results its Carmacks Gold project in Yukon. Hole CD-26-056 at Zone 2000S returned: 82.69 m of 1.12% copper with 0.64 g/t gold (1.78% CuEq), including 49.16 m of 1.63% copper with 0.95 g/t gold

CANEX Metals Inc. (V.CANX) Hit a new 52-Week High of 42 cents. Tuesday, CANEX announced that due to strong shareholder demand the Company has increased its previously announced non-brokered private placement and will now offer up to 21,428,571 common shares at a price of $0.35 per Common Share for proceeds of up to C$7.5 million.

Cerrado Gold Inc. (V.CERT) Hit a new 52-Week High of $2.72. Last week, Cerrado announced that it has closed the previously announced strategic non-brokered private placement financing with Eric Sprott for aggregate gross proceeds of C$10 million.

Covalon Technologies Ltd (V:COV) Hit a new 52-Week High of $3.54. Last week, Covalon reported Q3 revenue increased 20% year-over-year to $10 million, with all three sales channels contributing to growth. Adjusted EBITDA more than tripled to $3.0 million, reflecting efficient scaling with operating expenses up only 1%.

Cenovus Energy Inc. (T.CVE) Hit a new 52-Week High of $46.02. Cenovus is one of the biggest beneficiaries of favorable conditions in the oil sector. The company reported its best-ever quarterly financial performance for Q2. And in a major milestone, Cenovus is transitioning into one of the world's largest producers, producing more than one million barrels of oil equivalent per day.

CMX Gold & Silver Corp. (C.CXC) Hit a new 52-Week High of 30 cents. CMX is a junior mining company with a silver-lead-zinc property in the United States of America. The company's focus is on the development of its wholly-owned Clayton Silver Property located in Idaho, with the primary focus being to determine the feasibility of reactivating the mine. Geographically, it operates in Canada and the United States.

Liberty Gold Corp. (T.LGD) Hit a new 52-Week High of $2.08. Tuesday, Liberty Gold announced the results of a Feasibility Study prepared in accordance with National Instrument 43-101 – Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects at its 100%-owned Black Pine Oxide Gold Project in southern Idaho.

Mineros S.A. (T.MSA) Hit a new 52-Week High of $8.63. In mid-August, Mineros announced that it has entered the detailed engineering phase for the development of its 100%-owned Porvenir polymetallic deposit, located within the Hemco Property in Nicaragua, following an independent engineering review of the updated pre-feasibility study announced on March 31, 2026. A construction decision is expected in early 2027.

P2 Gold Inc. (V.PGLD) Hit a new 52-Week High of $1.27. In mid-August, P2 Gold reported results from three diamond drill holes and metallurgical test results for the Car Body Zone at its gold-copper Gabbs Project in Nevada, and provides updates on the Gabbs Project feasibility study underway.

Surge Energy Inc. (T.SGY) Hit a new 52-Week High of $11.46. Surge confirmed that a cash dividend to be paid on September 15, in respect of August 2026 production, for the shareholders of record on August 31, will be $0.043333 per share.

Swiss Water Decaffeinated Coffee Inc (T.SWP) Hit a new 52-Week High of $9.00. Swiss Water Decaffeinated announced that the Toronto Stock Exchange has approved the previously announced normal course issuer bid pursuant to which Swiss Water will purchase up to approximately 650,000 common shares, representing approximately 9.7% of its outstanding Common Shares in the public float as of August 7, 2026.

Teck Resources Limited (T.TECK-B) Hit a new 52-Week High of $99.65. Teck Resources has returned 214.2% over five years, which means anyone looking at the stock today is assessing it after a substantial re-rating by the market.

Total Energy Services Inc. (T.TOT) Hit a new 52-Week High of $34.27. Total Energy has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.12 (Cdn.) per common share for the quarter ending September 30, on Total Energy's outstanding common shares. The dividend is payable on October 15, to shareholders of record at the close of business on September 30.

Tamarack Valley Energy Ltd (T.TVE) Hit a new 52-Week High of $13.85. Tamarack Valley Energy and Headwater Exploration have signed a merger deal valued at $10 billion that they say will bring together their operations in the Clearwater region in Alberta.

title: Tamarack Valley, Cascadia, Arrow at 52-Week Highs on News
